# LoakinAja

> LoakinAja is an Indonesian marketplace for buying and selling quality pre-owned goods, with Rekening Bersama (escrow-style) transaction support.

LoakinAja helps people discover second-hand products, publish listings, and pay bills. Listings show their price, condition, location, photos, and seller information. In Rekening Bersama transactions, payment is held until delivery is confirmed; payment verification and seller payouts are currently handled manually by administrators.

## Main pages

- [Home](https://loakinaja.com/): Marketplace overview, categories, and current featured listings.
- [About LoakinAja](https://loakinaja.com/tentang-kami): Business and marketplace information.
- [Product categories](https://loakinaja.com/category/semua): Browse active listings.
- [Pricing](https://loakinaja.com/harga): Public listing-token package prices.
- [How to buy](https://loakinaja.com/cara-belanja): Buyer guide.
- [How to sell](https://loakinaja.com/cara-jualan): Seller guide.
- [Secure transactions](https://loakinaja.com/jaminan-aman): Rekening Bersama information.
- [Contact](https://loakinaja.com/hubungi-kami): Customer support details.
- [FAQ](https://loakinaja.com/faq): Frequently asked questions.
- [Terms](https://loakinaja.com/syarat-ketentuan): Terms and conditions.
- [Privacy](https://loakinaja.com/kebijakan-privasi): Privacy policy.
- [Sitemap](https://loakinaja.com/sitemap.xml): Public pages with last-modified dates.
